title: Observability timeseries window skew: backfill job and hotfix for tenant telemetry
creator: Maya Chen
description: Multiple enterprise customers reported dashboards showing zeroed or partial metric series and traces failing to stitch during a regional resharding event. Root cause analysis points to a timing regression in the tenant ingestion watermark update during resharding that allowed newer shards to be queried while the indexer had not completed tombstone reconciliation, producing window-skewed queries and missing series in the Console. This ticket tracks the emergency remediation (backfill/repair), the code hotfix to watermark handling, and customer communications for impacted accounts.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Trigger a controlled resharding on a test tenant with high-cardinality metrics
2) While resharding is underway, run live dashboard queries for 1h window and observe missing series for shards still reconciling
3) Correlate indexer logs for tombstone-processing and watermark updates to see ordering mismatch
4) Run trace-stitcher queries for the same time windows to reproduce gaps in trace links
mitigation: Deployed temporary query-router rule to fall back to stable shard snapshot for any tenant with active resharding. Enabled increased trace stitch sampling to capture partial traces for post-incident reconstruction. Issued message to affected customers with status and ETA for repair.

postmortem_actions: 1) Add transactional guard to ingestion watermark writes to ensure tombstone reconciliation completes before watermark advances
2) Add end-to-end resharding e2e test that verifies dashboard queries during rotation return consistent series
3) Automate query-router fallback for future resharding windows for any tenant with active rotation
4) Add additional alert that correlates resharding events with spike in 'series-zeroed' and 'trace-gap' metrics
5) Run broad backfill sweep for the last 7 days across any tenants that reported gaps
